comparison.objective: Insert an oriented SD card into a reader until its latch clicks.
comparison.physical_skill: One hand stabilizes the reader while the other aligns and pushes a thin keyed card into a slot.
comparison.success_condition: Card enters label-up and contacts-first until latched; force, damage, and final-pose thresholds are not stated.
comparison.reason: Shares bimanual stabilization and precision insertion, but its defining ability is keyed slot insertion and latching rather than controlled impact fracture and subsequent fragment search.
